name: LLM_ROUTE_TRUTH_20261110
comment: ANCHOR: LLM_ROUTE_TRUTH_20261110 — LQ-20261107-1808: a process may not declare deepseek_only AND anthropic_first (the deepseek lane ran on claude-haiku-5-5; 219/24h ANTHROPIC_INPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED), a failed lane read renders 'cannot be read: <reason>', never [], and the stored hermes_external_research.model names the executor from the lane's provenance, not the CLI's requested default.

r2 (25152d18b review): the lane no longer has an ungated door — --lane defaults to deepseek and a lane whose name/provider/default model is not on the process row's allowed_lanes is refused (LaneNotAdmitted / EXIT_LANE_GATED) before any credential read, .env load or socket; llm_consumption_log names the resolved provider model id on a RAISING call instead of NULL (34 rows/7d); and the coverage-stall alarm reads an uncounted deepseek flow as None (held, held_by=research_ok_unmeasured) instead of 0, so it cannot charge a flat thesis count to research nobody counted. Pins: tests/test_hermes_lane_admission_20261110.py, tests/test_llm_ledger_model_name_20261110.py, tests/test_research_lane_rows_unreadable_20261110.py.
